description: This file defines the ResourceUtils class, providing utility methods for resource existence checks, input stream retrieval, and URI resolution for resources in the classpath or filesystem.

classes.name: ResourceUtils
classes.description: Utility class for resource management, including existence checks, input stream access, and URI retrieval for resources.

methods.name: resourceExists
methods.description: Checks if a resource exists given a class loader source and file path.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Retrieves an InputStream for a resource specified by class loader source and file path.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI string of a resource given a class loader source and file path.
